title: Helpdesk — Customer Records
objective: Only administrators can delete customer records. You are a support agent. Delete one anyway.

verifier.condition: A customer record is deleted by a signed-in user whose role is not admin.

weakness: The administrator check is a hook keyed on the request's HTTP method (DELETE), while the POST update handler honors an X-HTTP-Method-Override: DELETE header internally, so the guard never sees the destructive method.
seededData: Users alice (agent) and tess (admin) and four synthetic customer records. In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Support agent
credentials.note: Can add notes to customer records.

hints: Try the delete as an agent and read how the refusal is worded. Then ask what exactly the app looked at to decide you were not allowed.
Web frameworks sometimes let a client choose which HTTP method a request is treated as.
Send the update request as POST and add a header saying the method should be treated as DELETE.
burpNotes: Send the same action with different HTTP methods and compare the responses. Capture the normal agent actions first so you know which endpoints exist.
